'''Nekowatt''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Kittazap]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Voltazar]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Some Tatari blur the line between work and life. Work should serve life, and too much of it would drain the 'watt' from Nekowatt!"

Nekowatt is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A sentient [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maneki-neko maneki-neko], the Japanese figurine and good luck symbol. On its neck is a [[pinball]] with a lightning bolt symbol on it. Nekowatt is also yellow with a white underbelly and white paws. Both of its ears are brown, and the end of its tail is brown as well. It has a dark red bow tied around its waist, and it lays on top of a round, light brown and green mat.

Nekowatt's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its yellow fur to gray, and brown fur becomes dark gray. 

== Evolution Trial ==
Nekowatt's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Voltazar]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Nekowatt to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 70 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x4200 fertilizer)

==Strategy==
[[File:Nekowatt Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Nekowatt's attack range]]
Nekowatt is a frontliner, being a Guardian and having minimal range. You should use [[Flameow]]/evo alongside Nekowatt because of the Paw Pals bond, giving Nekowatt a 3% ATK speed increase. In stages with hordes of regular [[Zobos]], Nekowatt could hold one lane.

When Nekowatt's skill cooldown reaches minimum, its attack range increases by 1 tile.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Nekowatt usually rides a roomba, but it settled for a mat since it's glamping season with its trainer."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "The lightning pinball on Nekowatt's neck can sense movements in the area and flashes intensely when Tatari other than [[Nekoflare]] approach."
